note: Harrison County, IN (FIPS 18061) publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (ZoningMap.pdf, which the page says is only a representation of the official map). The ordinance refers to a digital district layer, but no public ArcGIS REST or WFS service for it was found on the county site, the open-data searches, or ArcGIS Online. The county's GIS viewer is Beacon (Schneider), which sits behind a bot challenge and offers no public service. No city layer found either (Corydon has only a PDF map via the county).
